news-explainer.name: Fast news explainer (faceless, receipts and memes)
news-explainer.visuals: Something new every 2-3 s: receipts (headline or source card with the key words highlighted), stat cards, cut-out photos of the people with a bold caption, memes held 1-2 s, chapter text cards. Never the presenter's face
news-explainer.transitions: Hard cuts, elements pop in over 3-5 frames and stack on top of each other, slightly tilted. A short glitch only between sections
structure: The result first, then the twist. Fast montage, no greeting.
The one question this video answers.
Chronological receipts, one per beat, each with a one-line reaction.
The honest take, both sides, then a clear opinion.
Three-line recap, then a specific question for the comments.
